roster.tradesmanDefinitionsStatus: Roster approved; individual attributes, talents, and non-combat abilities pending

nonCombatAbility.name: Bountiful Harvest
nonCombatAbility.description: Identify soil quality, assess crop health, recognize when plants are ready to harvest
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Checks involving cultivation, crop care, and assessing farmland suitability

nonCombatAbility.name: Herdmaster
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Checks involving calming, feeding, raising, and managing domesticated livestock
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can recognize signs of illness or distress in farm animals

nonCombatAbility.name: Waterwise
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving locating productive fishing grounds, identifying fish behavior, interpreting currents and tides, and recognizing dangerous water conditions

nonCombatAbility.name: Gamekeeper
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Survival checks involving tracking wild game, recognizing animal trails, identifying signs of nearby wildlife, and locating suitable hunting grounds

nonCombatAbility.name: Nature's Bounty
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Survival checks involving finding edible plants, berries, roots, mushrooms, and useful wild herbs
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognize common poisonous plants and identify seasonal gathering locations

nonCombatAbility.name: Self-Sufficient
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving improvising basic shelters, maintaining a remote household, making practical repairs with limited supplies, and organizing resources for extended self-sufficient living

nonCombatAbility.name: Day's Work
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving hauling heavy supplies, moving construction materials, clearing debris, and performing prolonged manual labor

nonCombatAbility.name: Community Ties
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat social checks involving gaining the trust of ordinary villagers, requesting modest assistance, participating in community activities, and gathering local information in small settlements

nonCombatAbility.name: Urban Instincts
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving navigating unfamiliar cities, finding local services, recognizing unsafe neighborhoods, and locating useful information in crowded urban environments

nonCombatAbility.name: Unassuming Presence
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving blending in among household staff, learning information through everyday household activities, recognizing household routines, and navigating employers' social expectations

nonCombatAbility.name: Stablemaster
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Animal Handling checks involving grooming, feeding, calming, and caring for horses and other riding or draft animals
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes signs of fatigue, poor health, or improper equipment fitting in mounts

nonCombatAbility.name: Reliable Messenger
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving finding efficient delivery routes, locating recipients, remembering directions, and navigating established roads or delivery networks
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common waystations, messenger markings, and delivery procedures

nonCombatAbility.name: Sea Legs
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving maintaining balance aboard moving vessels, handling sails and rigging, securing cargo, and recognizing signs of approaching dangerous weather at sea
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Understands basic shipboard routines and nautical terminology

nonCombatAbility.name: Well-Traveled
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving recognizing regional customs, identifying useful travel routes, finding inns or safe lodging, and locating established trade roads
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common travel signs and road markers

nonCombatAbility.name: Roadside Refuge
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Survival checks involving finding secluded resting places, locating temporary shelter, identifying safe campsites, and using natural surroundings when traveling without reliable supplies
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes signs that a campsite has recently been occupied

nonCombatAbility.name: Shared Hardship
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat social checks involving gaining the trust of displaced people, seeking temporary shelter from sympathetic communities, finding mutual-aid networks, and negotiating basic necessities during periods of hardship
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common signs of displacement and humanitarian need

nonCombatAbility.name: Resourceful Survivor
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving finding basic necessities with limited resources, identifying charitable organizations or shelters, recognizing opportunities for informal work, and navigating unfamiliar communities without established support
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common signs of exploitation and dishonest offers of assistance

nonCombatAbility.name: Solitary Wisdom
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Survival checks involving establishing isolated living areas, finding secluded sources of food and water, maintaining a remote shelter, and recognizing disturbances in their surroundings
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify signs that someone recently passed through an otherwise isolated area

nonCombatAbility.name: Military Bearing
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving recognizing military ranks and insignia, understanding military protocols, navigating military camps, and interpreting army organization and supply procedures
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify common military formations and camp arrangements

nonCombatAbility.name: Keeper of the Peace
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat checks involving recognizing suspicious activity, investigating disturbances, identifying signs of unlawful entry, and understanding local security procedures
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common guard patrol patterns, watch schedules, and settlement security arrangements

nonCombatAbility.name: Stone Sense
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Mining checks involving recognizing valuable ore seams, assessing excavation stability, identifying signs of cave-ins, and locating workable deposits
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common mining tools, support structures, and signs of recent excavation

nonCombatAbility.name: Timberwise
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Woodcutting checks involving identifying useful timber, assessing tree health and stability, selecting safe felling directions, and recognizing dangerous or weakened branches
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify common wood types and estimate timber suitability for construction or crafting

nonCombatAbility.name: Mineral Eye
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Prospecting checks involving identifying promising mineral deposits, examining exposed rock formations, recognizing signs of precious metals or gemstones, and determining where further exploration may be worthwhile
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Recognizes common geological indicators of mineral-rich terrain

nonCombatAbility.name: Master of the Forge
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Blacksmithing checks involving forging metal objects, evaluating metal quality, identifying defects in forged equipment, and performing metalworking repairs
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify common metals, forging techniques, and signs of poor craftsmanship

nonCombatAbility.name: Woodworker's Eye
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Carpentry checks involving constructing wooden objects, evaluating timber quality, identifying structural weaknesses, and repairing wooden buildings, furniture, or equipment
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify woodworking techniques and recognize signs of poor construction

nonCombatAbility.name: Stoneworker's Eye
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Masonry checks involving shaping and fitting stone, assessing stonework quality, identifying structural weaknesses in masonry, and repairing stone buildings or fortifications
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify common stone construction techniques and recognize weakened mortar, settling foundations, or poor workmanship

nonCombatAbility.name: Hidecraft
nonCombatAbility.appliesTo: Non-combat Leatherworking checks involving tanning hides, assessing leather quality, crafting leather goods, and repairing leather equipment
nonCombatAbility.additionalEffect: Can identify different types of hides, recognize poor stitching or tanning, and assess suitability for armor, clothing, or other equipment

notes: These 20 Common background definitions are approved.
Attribute bonuses and skill talent percentages are percentage-point adjustments.
Skill governing attributes and other unapproved skill-system mechanics remain pending.
The approved Tradesman roster has 22 entries, including Sapper (the approved replacement name for Military Engineer). No individual Tradesman mechanics are yet approved.
